senses.gloss: m. (μύστρος, -ον) spoon.—מ׳ מכירין (v. מְכֵירִין) mystromacherion, an instrument having a spoon on one side and a knife on the other (cmp. Sm. Ant. s. v. Cochlear).
units: <cite ref="Vayikra Rabbah 33:1">Lev. R. s. 33</cite>, beg. (ref. to <cite ref="Proverbs 18:21">Prov. XVIII, 21</cite>) <he>תרגם עקילס מ׳ מ׳ וכ׳</he> Aquila interpreted it, ‘a spoon-knife’, death on one side and life on the other; Yalk. ib. 661 <he>מציטאר מ׳</he>; Yalk. Ps. 768 <he>מצטרו ומ׳</he> (read: <he>מצטרומ׳</he>).
